questions.topic: eGurukul · Lung Basics & Congenital Anomalies of Lungs
questions.stem: All of the following statements are true except

options.label: A
options.text: Lungs have a double arterial blood supply

options.label: B
options.text: Bronchioles have a cartilaginous ring

options.label: C
options.text: Blind end of the respiratory passage is the alveolar ducts and alveolar sac

options.label: D
options.text: Respiratory tree is lined by pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium except for the vocal cord

questions.solutionHtml:
Bronchioles have a cartilaginous ring
  • Bronchioles do not have cartilaginous rings. They have smooth muscle in their walls instead, which allows for their diameter to change during breathing.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 670

questions.topic: eGurukul · Lung Basics & Congenital Anomalies of Lungs
questions.stem: Which of the following is not true regarding pulmonary sequestration?

options.label: A
options.text: It lacks connection with the airway system

options.label: B
options.text: It has an abnormal blood supply

options.label: C
options.text: They are not associated with other congenital anomalies

options.label: D
options.text: Extralobar sequestration is most common in infants

questions.answerText: They are not associated with other congenital anomalies
questions.solutionHtml:
They are not associated with other congenital anomalies
  • Pulmonary sequestration is often associated with other congenital anomalies, such as congenital heart defects, diaphragmatic hernias, and other anomalies of the lung or chest wall.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 671

questions.topic: eGurukul · Lung Basics & Congenital Anomalies of Lungs
questions.stem: Which structure arises from abnormal detachments of primitive foregut and is most often located in the hilum or middle mediastinum?

options.label: A
options.text: pulmonary hypoplasia

options.label: B
options.text: Atelectasis

options.label: C
options.text: Foregut cyst

options.label: D
options.text: Pulmonary sequestration

questions.solutionHtml:
Foregut cyst
  • Foregut cysts arise from abnormal detachments of primitive foregut and are most often located in the hilum or middle mediastinum.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 670

questions.topic: eGurukul · Lung Basics & Congenital Anomalies of Lungs
questions.stem: Which of the following statement are true regarding the pathogenesis of acute lung injury?

options.label: A
options.text: Endothelial activation is the early event

options.label: B
options.text: Adhesion and extravasation of neutrophils occurs

options.label: C
options.text: Accumulation of intra-alveolar fluid and formation of hyaline membranes is also seen

options.label: D
options.text: All of the above

questions.solutionHtml:
All of the above
  • All of the above statements are true regarding the pathogenesis of acute lung injury.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 672-73

questions.topic: eGurukul · Lung Basics & Congenital Anomalies of Lungs
questions.stemHtml: A 42-year-old patient was admitted to the hospital with chief complaints of dyspnoea and tachypnoea. Based on the histological picture given below, what is your diagnosis?

options.label: A
options.text: Acute lung injury

options.label: B
options.text: Asthma

options.label: C
options.text: Emphysema

options.label: D
options.text: Chronic bronchitis

questions.solutionHtml:
Acute lung injury
  • The given clinical history and a histopathological image showing diffuse alveolar damage is suggestive of Acute lung injury.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 673

questions.topic: eGurukul · Lung Basics & Congenital Anomalies of Lungs
questions.stem: All of the following statements are true regarding Goodpasture syndrome except:

options.label: A
options.text: It is a type II hypersensitivity reaction

options.label: B
options.text: There is an antibody against the collagen part of the beta 3 chain of collagen VI

options.label: C
options.text: Focal alveolar necrosis is seen on HPE

options.label: D
options.text: Immunofluorescence shows linear deposits along the basement membranes

questions.answerText: There is an antibody against the collagen part of the beta 3 chain of collagen VI
questions.solutionHtml:
There is an antibody against the collagen part of the beta 3 chain of collagen VI
  • Goodpasture syndrome is an uncommon autoimmune disease in which kidney and lung injuries are caused by circulating autoantibodies against the noncollagenous domain of the α3 chain of collagen IV.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 701
